_comment: Tap-to-define terms. Keep 'short' to one or two plain sentences - this is the safety net for someone who does not have every term memorized yet. 'concept' optionally points at a concept id to open for the full story.

kube-apiserver.short: The front door to the cluster. Every request and every component goes through it, and it is the only thing that talks to etcd.

etcd.short: The cluster's database. Every object you create is stored here, and nothing else is remembered.

kube-controller-manager.short: One process running dozens of small loops that keep reality matching what you asked for.

kube-scheduler.short: Decides which node each new pod runs on. It only picks a node; it never starts containers.

kubelet.short: The agent on every node. It watches for pods assigned to its node and makes them real.

kube-proxy.short: Programs the kernel rules on each node that turn a Service IP into a real pod IP.

control plane.short: The brains: API server, etcd, scheduler and controllers. It decides things; nodes do things.

data plane.short: The nodes and the containers actually serving your traffic.

node.short: A machine (VM or physical) that runs pods.

pod.short: The smallest thing you can run: one or more containers sharing an IP and a lifetime.

container runtime.short: The software that actually starts containers. On RKE2 that is containerd.

containerd.short: The container runtime RKE2 ships and runs itself. It pulls images and starts containers.

CRI.short: Container Runtime Interface - the gRPC API the kubelet uses to ask containerd to run something.

crictl.short: A CLI that talks straight to containerd. Works even when the API server is down.

runc.short: The low-level tool that creates the actual Linux process, namespaces and cgroups.

pause container.short: A tiny container that holds a pod's network namespace so the others can share one IP.

static pod.short: A pod the kubelet runs from a YAML file on disk, with no API server involved. How RKE2 starts the control plane.

mirror pod.short: The read-only copy of a static pod that shows up in kubectl. Deleting it changes nothing.

Lease.short: A tiny object a node updates every 10 seconds to say 'I am still alive'.

leader election.short: Several copies run, but only the one holding a Lease is allowed to act. Stops two controllers fighting.

quorum.short: The majority of etcd members. Without a majority, nothing can be written.

Raft.short: The agreement algorithm etcd uses so a majority of members always agree on the data.

revision.short: etcd's global version counter. It ticks up on every write in the whole cluster.

resourceVersion.short: A version stamp on every object. Used to detect conflicting edits and to resume watches.

watch.short: A long-lived connection that streams changes to a client instead of making it poll.

informer.short: A client-side cache kept fresh by a watch. Controllers read from it instead of hammering the API server.

reconcile.short: Look at what is wanted, look at what exists, and close the gap. Repeat forever.

controller.short: A loop that watches some objects and works to make reality match them.

operator.short: A controller for your own custom resource type, usually packaging app-specific knowledge.

CRD.short: CustomResourceDefinition - teaches the API server a new object type. Storage only; a controller gives it meaning.

CR.short: Custom Resource - one instance of a type defined by a CRD.

admission.short: The checkpoint after authorization where requests can be changed or rejected before being saved.

admission webhook.short: Your own HTTPS service that the API server calls to approve or modify every matching request.

mutating.short: An admission step that can change the object, for example injecting a sidecar.

validating.short: An admission step that can only accept or reject, never change.

failurePolicy.short: What happens when a webhook is unreachable: Fail rejects the request, Ignore lets it through.

authentication.short: Who are you? Certificates, tokens, OIDC. Failing gives a 401.

authorization.short: Are you allowed to do this? Almost always RBAC. Failing gives a 403.

RBAC.short: Role-Based Access Control: rules saying which verbs an identity may use on which resources. Permissions only add up; there is no deny.

Role.short: A list of allowed verbs on resources, inside one namespace.

ClusterRole.short: Like a Role, but cluster-wide, or for things that have no namespace such as nodes.

RoleBinding.short: Gives a Role (or a ClusterRole) to someone, inside one namespace.

ClusterRoleBinding.short: Gives a ClusterRole to someone across the whole cluster.

ServiceAccount.short: An identity for pods. Its token is mounted into the pod so it can call the API.

impersonation.short: One identity acting as another, on purpose and audited. Rancher uses this to proxy your kubectl.

ownerReference.short: A pointer from a child object to its parent. When the parent goes, the child is cleaned up.

garbage collector.short: The loop that deletes objects whose owner no longer exists.

finalizer.short: A note on an object meaning 'do not really delete this until I have cleaned up'. The usual reason things get stuck Terminating.

deletionTimestamp.short: Set when you delete something that has a finalizer. The object stays, marked as going away.

Deployment.short: Manages ReplicaSets to run N copies of a pod and roll out new versions.

ReplicaSet.short: Keeps exactly N identical pods running. A rollout is really one ReplicaSet growing while another shrinks.

StatefulSet.short: Like a Deployment but each replica gets a stable name, a stable DNS entry and its own disk.

DaemonSet.short: Runs one copy of a pod on every node. Used for CNI, kube-proxy, log agents.

maxSurge.short: How many extra pods may exist above the desired count during a rollout.

maxUnavailable.short: How many pods may be missing or not ready during a rollout.

requests.short: What a pod reserves. The scheduler adds these up to decide if a pod fits on a node.

limits.short: The ceiling at runtime. Over the CPU limit means throttling; over the memory limit means the process is killed.

allocatable.short: What a node actually offers to pods: total capacity minus what is reserved for the OS and kubelet.

QoS class.short: Guaranteed, Burstable or BestEffort. Decides who gets evicted first when a node runs low.

OOMKilled.short: The kernel killed the container for using more memory than its limit. Exit code 137.

eviction.short: The kubelet removing pods because the whole node is short on memory or disk.

throttling.short: The kernel slowing a container down because it hit its CPU limit. No crash, just latency.

cgroup.short: The Linux feature that caps and accounts a process group's CPU and memory. How limits are enforced.

taint.short: A mark on a node that repels pods unless they explicitly tolerate it.

toleration.short: A note on a pod saying 'I can live with that taint'. It permits placement, it does not attract.

cordon.short: Stop new pods landing on a node. Existing pods stay.

drain.short: Cordon a node and then evict its pods, respecting PodDisruptionBudgets.

affinity.short: Rules pulling a pod towards certain nodes, or towards/away from other pods.

anti-affinity.short: Keep these pods apart, usually one per node or per zone.

topologySpreadConstraints.short: Spread replicas evenly across zones or nodes, with a tolerance for how uneven it may get.

PodDisruptionBudget.short: A floor on how many pods must stay up during planned disruption like a drain. Does not help when hardware dies.

PDB.short: PodDisruptionBudget: how many pods must stay up during a drain or scale-down.

preemption.short: A high-priority pod evicting lower-priority pods to make room for itself.

PriorityClass.short: A number saying how important a pod is. Higher wins when there is not enough room.

CNI.short: Container Network Interface - the plugin that gives pods IPs and makes them reach each other.

Canal.short: RKE2's default networking: Flannel moves the packets, Calico enforces NetworkPolicy.

Calico.short: A CNI plugin. In RKE2 it usually provides the NetworkPolicy half of Canal.

Cilium.short: An eBPF-based CNI, offered by RKE2 as an alternative to Canal.

VXLAN.short: Wrapping pod packets inside normal node-to-node packets. Costs about 50 bytes, which is why MTU matters.

MTU.short: The biggest packet a link accepts. Too big for the tunnel and large transfers hang while small ones work.

ClusterIP.short: A virtual IP for a Service. Nothing listens on it; the kernel rewrites packets to a real pod IP.

Service.short: A stable name and IP in front of a changing set of pods.

EndpointSlice.short: The live list of pod IPs behind a Service. Only ready pods are in it.

headless.short: A Service with no virtual IP: DNS returns the pod IPs directly. What StatefulSets use.

NodePort.short: A Service also reachable on a fixed high port on every node.

LoadBalancer.short: A Service that asks something outside Kubernetes for an external IP. On bare metal that is MetalLB or RKE2's ServiceLB.

Ingress.short: HTTP routing rules. Inert unless an ingress controller is installed to act on them.

ingress controller.short: The proxy that reads Ingress objects and actually serves the traffic. RKE2 ships ingress-nginx.

CoreDNS.short: The cluster's DNS server. Turns Service names into ClusterIPs.

ndots.short: How many dots a name needs before DNS tries it as-is. The default of 5 makes external lookups do extra failed queries first.

NetworkPolicy.short: A firewall for pods. A pod ignores all policies until one selects it - then only what is allowed gets through.

conntrack.short: The kernel's table of live connections. It remembers the translation so replies find their way back.

PersistentVolumeClaim.short: A request for storage of a given size and type. Lives in a namespace.

PVC.short: PersistentVolumeClaim: a pod's request for a piece of storage.

PersistentVolume.short: The actual piece of storage, bound one-to-one with a claim. Cluster-wide, not namespaced.

PV.short: PersistentVolume: the real storage behind a claim.

StorageClass.short: The recipe for creating storage on demand: which driver, which settings, and what happens on delete.

reclaim policy.short: What happens to the real disk when the claim is deleted. Delete destroys it; Retain keeps it.

WaitForFirstConsumer.short: Do not create the disk until a pod is scheduled, so it lands in the right zone.

CSI.short: Container Storage Interface - the plugin API storage vendors implement to create, attach and mount volumes.

VolumeAttachment.short: An object recording which node a disk is currently attached to.

ReadWriteOnce.short: The volume can be mounted read-write by pods on one node at a time.

liveness probe.short: Is this process wedged? Failing restarts the container.

readiness probe.short: Should this pod get traffic right now? Failing removes it from the Service, without restarting it.

startup probe.short: Gives a slow-booting app time before the other probes start judging it.

preStop.short: A hook that runs before SIGTERM. A few seconds of sleep here removes most rollout 502s.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.short: How long a pod gets to shut down before it is killed outright. The clock covers preStop too.

SIGTERM.short: The polite 'please stop' signal. Ignore it and you get SIGKILL when the grace period ends.

CrashLoopBackOff.short: The container keeps starting and exiting, so the kubelet is waiting longer between tries. An app problem, not a cluster one.

ImagePullBackOff.short: The image could not be pulled: wrong tag, no credentials, or the registry is unreachable.

Pending.short: No node has accepted the pod yet. A scheduling problem, not a container problem.

NotReady.short: The control plane has stopped hearing healthy status from that node's kubelet.

RKE2.short: Rancher's Kubernetes distribution: one binary, a systemd unit, its own containerd, control plane as static pods.

rke2-server.short: The systemd unit on a control-plane node. It starts the whole control plane.

rke2-agent.short: The systemd unit on a worker node. It runs the kubelet and containerd only.

supervisor.short: RKE2's own service on port 9345 that new nodes talk to in order to join and fetch certificates.

helm-controller.short: RKE2's built-in installer: it turns a HelmChart object into a Job that runs helm.

HelmChartConfig.short: The supported way to change RKE2's bundled add-ons. Your values are merged in and survive restarts.

tls-san.short: Extra names and IPs to put in the API server certificate. Set it before you build the cluster.

registries.yaml.short: The file that tells containerd about private registries: mirrors, credentials and CA certs.

etcd snapshot.short: A point-in-time copy of the whole cluster state. Restoring rewinds everything, not one namespace.

Rancher.short: A management UI and API for many clusters, itself running as an app on one Kubernetes cluster.

local cluster.short: In Rancher, the cluster Rancher itself runs on. Its etcd is Rancher's database.

downstream cluster.short: Any cluster Rancher manages, as opposed to the one Rancher runs on.

cattle-cluster-agent.short: The pod in a managed cluster that dials out to Rancher and holds the tunnel open.

rancher-system-agent.short: A per-node service that applies Rancher's plans: installing RKE2, writing config, running upgrades.

Fleet.short: Rancher's GitOps engine, built to deploy the same git repo to many clusters selected by label.

GitRepo.short: The Fleet object naming a repo, branch and paths to watch.

Bundle.short: What Fleet rendered from a repo path, before it is sent to any particular cluster.

BundleDeployment.short: One bundle's state on one specific cluster. Where Fleet errors actually show up.

Cluster API.short: The upstream project for managing clusters as Kubernetes objects. Rancher builds its RKE2 provisioning on it.

namespace.short: A folder for objects, used for names, RBAC and quotas. Not a security boundary on its own.

manifest.short: The YAML describing an object you want to exist.

sidecar.short: An extra container in the same pod that supports the main one, such as a proxy or log shipper.

kubeconfig.short: The file holding the cluster address and your credentials for kubectl.
